skill_text.wave: Raise the end of one limb to about the top of the body, bent so its end points up, swing it side to side several times as if waving hello, then lower it.
skill_text.point: Stretch one limb fully toward a spot in front of or beside the body, as if pointing; hold it still a moment, then bring it back.
skill_text.reach_forward: Reach the end of one limb far out in front, the body leaning a little into it, then bring it back.
skill_text.crouch: Lower the body smoothly by bending the legs, trunk tipping forward a little; stay low a moment, then stand back up.
skill_text.turn_in_place: Turn the whole body on the spot to face a clearly different direction, a quarter turn or more, without travelling.
skill_text.trace_circle: Move the end of one limb smoothly around one large round circle in the air and finish where it began.
skill_text.bow: Tip the front of the body forward and down, as in a bow, then come back upright.
skill_text.twist: Turn the body left and right about the vertical a few times while staying in place.
skill_text.kick_swing: Swing the end of one limb quickly forward, as in a kick, then bring it back.
skill_text.step_forward: Walk forward a short distance, lifting and setting down each foot.
skill_text.tap_twice: Touch the ground or the surface below with the end of one limb two separate times, lifting it in between.
skill_text.lift_and_hold: Lift the end of one limb up and hold it still in the air for a moment.
skill_text.taskblind: No task: the model was given only the robot's primitives and asked for a varied, natural motion.
